headline: Character.AI files for bankruptcy and moves to sell assets to Disney
summary: Character.AI filed for bankruptcy and is selling some assets to Disney for $20 million, after facing scrutiny and lawsuits over chatbot safety, including a case linked to child suicide. New York Attorney General Letitia James said she and 40 bipartisan state attorneys general filed notice in the bankruptcy case, seeking protections for users' data.
